headlines.title: Ticks that cause Lyme and other diseases have migrated south. Are doctors ready?
headlines.description: New research from the CDC finds that ticks that cause diseases keep marching into new areas.

headlines.title: What Parents Should Know About Trump’s Change to Vaccinations
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s new executive order cuts the number of vaccines recommended for all children from 18 to 11. The administration cites rising autism rates for the change, though rigorous studies over decades have shown no link between vaccines and autism. NBC’s medical contributor Dr. John Torres reports in this week’s Sunday Focus on what families should know about vaccines as students head back to school.

headlines.title: Surrogate Gives Birth Amid Legal Dispute With Biological Parents
headlines.description: A baby born on Wednesday is now in the custody of his biological parents. The surrogate had fled to Texas to give birth after the parents asked her to terminate the pregnancy at 20 weeks when the baby was diagnosed with a severe heart defect. Now, the surrogate is fighting to get the baby back. NBC's Ryan Chandler reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Pregnant women having to travel further to deliver
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on how hospitals across the country have been closing labor and delivery units, meaning more women have to travel further to deliver their babies. In Lincoln County, Maine, the only delivery unit is set to close later this year, leaving expectant mothers scrambling.

headlines.title: Custody battle between biological parents and surrogate
headlines.description: The biological parents of a baby boy, born via surrogate, are fighting for custody after the gestational carrier refused to have an abortion when they learned about a serious heart defect at 20 weeks pregnant. Instead, the Alaska based surrogate fled to Texas where she carried the baby to term, and is now fighting for parental rights. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler has the latest.

headlines.title: This dentist-recommended Philips Sonicare electric toothbrush is under $35 right now
headlines.description: This electric toothbrush comes recommended by dentists and will last up to two weeks on a full charge. It’s on sale on Amazon for $35 right now.

headlines.title: Pattern Beauty just launched a new styling tool for natural hair — here’s everything you should know
headlines.description: Pattern Beauty just launched a vibrating flat iron, along with two new hair care and styling products — and you can shop them starting today.

headlines.title: Anthropologie’s viral beauty advent calendar just dropped — get it before it sells out
headlines.description: Anthropologie’s beloved beauty Advent calendars just dropped for 2026. Shop the 12- or 24-day options packed with skin care, makeup and fragrance favorites before they sell out.

headlines.title: The best backpacks for kids, tested and reviewed
headlines.description: Looking for the best backpack for kids? A mom tested 7 top-rated options for a month, from State to L.L.Bean, to find the most durable, spacious and kid-approved picks for elementary school.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order aiming to cut the number of required vaccines for children
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.
